title: Ethanol + water + ethyl acetate, UNIQUAC, 18 stages, a reflux ratio of 2 and 99.99 mass % water in the bottoms: CHEPTA-Lab's column SCDS15 at its phase boundary
purpose: Proposal 0028, item 1: the column that took most of CHEPTA-Lab's design-specification run (public repository FaireDose/CHEPTA-Lab, cases/ethyl-acetate-piotrowski-2021, results-chepta-main-415da41/new-plant-ds-ethanol0.0004.request.json, block SCDS15: 18 stages, feed on 9, total condenser, reflux ratio 2, bottoms_purity water 0.9999 mass, phases VLL, 100 kPa), with its feed S28 as CHEPTA computed it in that flowsheet with the ethanol feed F1 fixed at 6503.5 kg/h (the phase boundary named by the maintainer, 2026-11-26), on PR #269's code: ethanol 148.629305, water 6492.807130, ethyl acetate 139.026044 kmol/h at 343.15 K and 100 kPa (vapour fraction 0.0115). The feed's 2.9e-6 kmol/h of acetic acid is left out, as in F5, so that the reference's three components describe it. A simulated feed, not data.
method_choice: CHEPTA-Lab's: UNIQUAC with the default sets, ideal-gas vapour (docs/METHOD_SELECTION.md rules 3 and 7: polar, below 10 bar, two liquids possible: an activity model).

engine_against_reference.why: Proposal 0015, Engineering basis: flows within 1e-6 relative of the independent MESH solution. Both solve the same equations to residuals of 1e-8 or less, so the difference is the solvers' convergence only.

balances_on_every_stage.why: Proposal 0015: every stage's balances closed to 1e-8. Material: |residual| / F; energy: |residual| / (F x 10 kJ/mol); summation and equilibrium are mole fractions.

stability.why: one-liquid stages: no trial liquid on a grid has a tangent-plane distance below -1e-9

agreement_with_data.note: The three NRTL sets are fitted to vapour-liquid data; their liquid-liquid split is W1's work (joint fits, M2b) and not a test of the column.
